description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Organizations class, which manages organization data within the application. It includes methods for creating organizations, finding organizations by name, and checking name availability, utilizing Moose and Catalyst frameworks.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Organizations
classes.description: A Moose-based Catalyst model class for managing organization entities, providing methods for creation, lookup, and name validation.

methods.name: ACCEPT_CONTEXT
methods.description: Sets the schema attribute from the Catalyst context for each request.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new organization with provided arguments, ensuring the name is unique and assigning an owner user.

methods.name: find_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves an organization record matching the given name.

methods.name: name_available
methods.description: Checks if a given username or organization name is available, not used or blacklisted.
